payload.core_mechanism_summary: Checks two possible stripe orientations (horizontal if n%3==0, vertical if m%3==0) by iterating in blocks, verifying uniformity and distinct colors.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively validates the two possible flag arrangements. Among the candidate subtypes, branch_and_bound is selected as it somewhat resembles pruning when a block fails uniformity, but no real bounding is used. No other subtype fits better.
